tools.name: register_profile
tools.description: Register the fictional employment-support profile from NextStep's own signed-in session and mission-authorised employment context. No identity arguments or additional human approval are needed. No job application is submitted.

tools.name: match_roles
tools.description: Read fictional demo opportunities matching the signed-in NextStep profile. Register the profile first. This search changes no employment record and submits no applications; its results are saved to the mission.
